annotation.title_clean: Conceptualizing Trust in Objects of Speculation: A Narrative Approach to Robot Governance
annotation.title_en: Conceptualizing Trust in Objects of Speculation: A Narrative Approach to Robot Governance
annotation.venue: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, Vol. 335 (Robophilosophy 2020), IOS Press
annotation.summary_en: Robophilosophy 2020 conference paper developing a conceptual approach to trust in emerging robotics within technology governance. It frames robots as speculative objects, argues for a narrative approach to robot trajectories, and proposes a concept for analysing trust building through governance. Only the abstract is available.
key_provisions_or_claims: Robotics is an emerging technology with a speculative character and differing societal expectations.
Robots as speculative objects warrant engagement through a narrative approach to robot trajectories.
Proposes a concept for analysing trust building through technology governance.
